newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Noven cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Noven cut to neutral.

text.p: --Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Wednesday it lowered its rating on Noven Pharmaceuticals Inc to neutral from buy.

--Rodman said Noven management told analysts of a 1996 Q4 shortfall in product sales of estrogen patches due to inventory buildup by two licensees, Novartis AG and Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc, that will continue into 1997.
--Rodman's 1997 per share projection on Noven is for a loss of $0.10. It previously had expected a profit of $0.40 per share.
